question: Test whether face-local readout can detect odd balance and determine minimal universal coverage.
assumptions: Mean-zero carrier and copied primal flags in the closed Whitney model.
Common-phase preparation for individual face guards.
Shared atomic transition is assumed for candidate actuation.
target_exposure: First directed half-stock hold target established in C06 v0.16–v0.17
fitted_choices: Face-local receipt with shared atomic commit is a declared candidate; no empirical fit

sources.source_status: integrated flag metric and sector rates

baseline: C06 v0.21 incidence and v0.19 common-phase preparation
result: Each face sum annihilates mean-zero even data. Three faces suffice for universal detection under common phase. Any two have a blind odd preparation. Full summed face balance recovers twice the odd stock balance.
next_discriminant: Test physical access to face sums, shared commit and an off-range error bound.
